Name: StarDerg Valley Dialogues Tweak
Author: MarbleGateKeeper
Description:
A [b]WORK-IN-PROGRESS[/b] mod aims to provide more immersive dialogues alongside FSL6's StarDerg Valley mod. It supports English and Simplified Chinese.
Due to the differences between languages, Chinese is currently best supported.

[b]Supported Dialogues[/b]
Character Dialogues (Including marriage dialogues): Alex, Clint, Elliott, Krobus, Lewis, Linus, Harvey, Sam, Robin, Pierre, Shane, Sebastian, Willy, Abigail, Emily, Haley, Leah, Maru, Penny, Caroline, Demetrius, Evelyn, George, Gus, Jodi, Wizard.
Rainy Day Dialogues.

这是一款[b]正在开发中的[/b]MOD，旨在为烦君（FSL6）的星龙谷MOD提供更具沉浸感的对话。支持英语和简体中文。

[b]支持的对话[/b]
角色对话（包括婚后对话）：亚历克斯，艾利欧特，哈维，山姆，塞巴斯蒂安，谢恩，克林特，刘易斯，莱纳斯，皮埃尔，罗宾，威利，阿比盖尔，艾米丽，海莉，莉亚，玛鲁，潘妮，卡洛琳，德米特里厄斯，艾芙琳，乔治，格斯，乔迪，法师
雨天对话
